summary:
## Standing operator rules
Always run make license-check from the repository root after changing requirements/base.txt. Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing. Do not raise the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50; it caused lock contention and deadlocks in staging. Staging writes must use cache-eu-3; cache-eu-1 is being drained and must not receive writes. Never create a service-specific Google Cloud NAT gateway for ledgerly; use the gateway named ledgerly-shared-prod-nat instead.

## Current objective
Improve test setup/runtime; vendor-credit CSV import is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Pool size 50 caused lock contention/deadlocks. Per-document embedding clients were replaced with a shared client.

## Recent work
Typed billing helpers, fixed percentage-discount Decimal conversion and UTC timestamps, and passed billing/mypy checks. Diagnosed `apply_credit` ordering, which caused post-refund total to remain `$90.00` instead of `$87.50`. Established the 318-test baseline, then added invoice/organization factory fixtures, a transactional `db_session`, batched customers, and a frozen clock. Targeted suites pass.
